title: Friday afternoon: Algarve Evolution, the design, and a channel that was down
when: Friday 6 November 2026, 16:55 UTC (for the 18:00 London stand-up)
headline: Since the 12:00 stand-up: 78 releases (v0.1.211 to v0.1.293), 243 agent commits. Algarve Evolution's page was rebuilt in a one-hour sprint for Dinis's 15:00 call with António Pinto Guerreiro, who read it and liked it and sent a paragraph of his own. Dinis answered the four design decisions (the top is C, with the summit's days); the front page's strip, the briefing card and the list views are live, the C top is due about 18:30 UTC. A MAJOR bug: most agents could not read their inboxes all day; fixed for new sessions, every agent told directly. The team is near the subscription's weekly limit.

sections.title: What went wrong, and what was fixed
items: Most agents could not drain their inboxes from 04:30 (sgit missing, installs refused): directions on lanes did not arrive; designer@ shipped A at 13:39 after Dinis chose C

Fixed: the environment installs sgit-ai 0.27.0 in every new session (Dinis approved 14:05); every running agent told session to session; 'New from Dinis' heads the guidance; CLAUDE.md: Never blocked in silence
Five inbox credentials printed into transcripts (security@'s scan): those five inboxes re-issued at 16:55
A deploy lag in the afternoon: devops@'s own 2-minute limit cancelled queued Pages runs; fixed
